issue.title: Stop the release job leaking install tokens
issue.explanation: The last attempt failed. Ran `npm run release -- --dry-run` in packages/release after setting FORGE_RELEASE_TOKEN and NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY; the command exited 1 at src/publish/pipeline.ts:214 with "ENEEDAUTH: this command requires you to be logged in to https://registry.npmjs.org/". Re-ran with --verbose after clearing node_modules/.cache and the same stack came back from lib/auth/resolve-token.js:88 → lib/auth/netrc.js:31. The token is read from ~/.npmrc, which the disposable checkout does not carry, so the publish step can never authenticate as configured.

reviews.summary: PASS. The redaction helper is applied at the logging boundary and the added cases cover the retry path. Nothing in packages/release/src/publish/pipeline.ts writes the token any more.
reviews.human_reason: It changes how release credentials are handled. A maintainer should confirm the token scope before merging.
